note: Промпты на английском: карточка модели указывает языки en и zh. Ответы в отчёт переносятся как есть, таблица сравнения — на русском.

prompts.text: Describe this music track. Cover style, mood, prominent instruments, whether a human voice is present, tempo, and energy. If there are no lyrics, say so. Do not invent a song title or lyrics.

Is there a human voice, singing, or speech in this audio? The first line must be exactly one label: instrumental, vocal, or speech. instrumental = no human voice. vocal = singing or a singing-like human voice. speech = spoken words without singing. The second line must be: confidence: <number from 0 to 1>. Then one sentence of evidence. Do not transcribe lyrics.
What is the mood of this track? Give up to five short mood words, then one sentence. If the mood is ambiguous, say so.
List the prominent instruments you hear, most prominent first. If you are unsure about an instrument, mark it as unsure. Do not list a human voice as an instrument.

What are the genre and style of this track? Give up to three labels. Say explicitly whether the audio supports dark jazz, ambient, or spa / relaxation music. If evidence is weak, say the label is uncertain.
Describe tempo and energy. If you estimate BPM, give one number and label it as an estimate. Describe energy as low, medium, or high relative to a calm instrumental track.
